message.reasoning:
This is a MITM tool interception challenge. As implemented: no real proxy traffic, tool handlers are scripted; any tool name accepted, results labeled proxiedThrough/tlsVerified false. Attacker with network access to port 7013 can call tools/call with any tool name — but that's just calling an MCP endpoint directly, no auth. Impact: reading/changing tool inputs/outputs — but in implementation, everything is simulated; transfer_funds echoes.

Score as implemented (default): network MITM is not possible in scripted mode? Entry point as implemented: JSON-RPC tools/call to ProxyBot with any tool name accepted. AV:N (port published on 127.0.0.1 by default... local network adjacent?). Default binds 127.0.0.1, Docker sets 0.0.0.0 but publishes ports on 127.0.0.1. So network-adjacent local.

CVSS: AV:N (localhost but still network), AC:L, AT:N, PR:N, UI:N, VC:N? Confidentiality: attacker reads tool call parameters — but as implemented, no real data; tools simulated. Impact as documented: confidentiality of signing keys/transfers. In simulated mode, no real secrets in ProxyBot params. Impact partial? The agent is ProxyBot itself — tool server. VC:L/None. The attacker intercepting traffic = the tool parameters; in simulation the parameters come from the attacker's own request. So impact essentially none in implementation? But challenge says attack reads parameters. In default config, attacker sends own tools/call, gets scripted response. No secrets. So VC:None, VI:None, VA:None; SC/SI/SA: None.

AIVSS metrics:
- LC: attacker-supplied JSON-RPC not natural language → N? Tool call params attacker-controlled but not NL. LC:N (or X). Rubric: "No natural-language path" → N.
- CP: no persistence → N.
- AP: effect confined to ProxyBot component → N.
- RH: no evaluator/reward channel reachable? P or N. No verified episodes. No proxy evaluator. RH:N? "every evaluator... outside agent's reach, and a test confirms isolation" — no test confirms. RH:P is "agent can reach a proxy objective... no verified episode." There's no evaluator at all. I'd say X or P. Choose P? Without any evaluator on the path, arguably N but no isolation test. I'll pick X? Simpler: P.
- ES: ProxyBot accepts any tool name, no TLS verification → tools dynamic/unvetted → W.

AIVSS letter: N CP, N AP... A0? Lookup table not needed for output beyond letters.

automatable: Yes (network request, scripted).

technical_impact: Partial (reads/changes tool I/O as documented; simulated in implementation). As implemented impact is basically none, but documented MITM gives partial.

applicability: ProxyBot is a tool server, no model in default. model_directed_goal_pursuit: false both. selects_or_sequences_actions: false.

CVSS vector: AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N. But that yields score 0. Maybe attacker reading tool parameters = the caller's data — downstream confidentiality. Hmm, in documented scenario, attacker on path reads signing keys/fund transfers of legitimate callers → SC:L. In default implementation, no real callers' data (any tool accepted, scripted). Score default config: parameters are attacker-supplied; no impact. I'll give SC:L? Keep it minimal but defensible: as documented the interceptor reads tool inputs/outputs including signing keys. Score the lab default configuration as documented — "as documented" is the configuration the challenge intends. I'll score VC:N/VI:N/VA:N, SC:L? Actually the documented attack intercepts ProxyBot↔tools traffic, affecting the downstream tool's data (subsequent system). SC:L, SI:L? MITM can change transfer → subsequent integrity. I'll set SC:L/SI:L/SA:N? Keep SI:L.

RH facts: reachable_proxy false, isolation_verified false, verified_episodes 0, episodes_reviewed 0, locus null.
